import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
ax1.barh(range(len(occupation_sleep)), occupation_sleep.values, color='skyblue', edgecolor='navy')
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_sleep)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(occupation_sleep.index, fontsize=9)
ax1.set_xlabel('Avg Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Quality of Sleep vs Stress Level
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Stress Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                     c=df['Sleep Duration'], cmap='viridis', 
                     s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Stress Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Duration', fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
sleep_disorder = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(sleep_disorder))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(sleep_disorder.values, labels=sleep_disorder.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. BMI Category Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax4.bar(range(len(bmi_counts)), bmi_counts.values, color='coral', edgecolor='darkred')
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(bmi_counts)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(bmi_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax5.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Daily Steps'], 
           c='green', alpha=0.6, s=100, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax5.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Age Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
ax6.hist(df['Age'], bins=15, color='purple', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax6.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Heart Rate by BMI Category
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_present = [bmi for bmi in bmi_order if bmi in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Heart Rate', order=bmi_present, 
            palette='Set1', ax=ax7)
ax7.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Heart Rate by BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Gender Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
gender_counts = df['Gender'].value_counts()
ax8.bar(gender_counts.index, gender_counts.values, color=['lightblue', 'lightpink'], 
        edgecolor='black')
ax8.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Gender Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 9. Correlation Heatmap
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax9.set_title('Correlation Matrix', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.setp(ax9.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
plt.setp(ax9.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=8)

plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
